history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.description: In the archers-x4 and archers-x8 worlds on borg-reborn-rs d098aee7 (track-p 5cb95bc0 plus #998 and #999, both rules shipped on), do the unseen-shooter rule (#981, recover_unseen_shot) and the cure-before-rest rule (#982, recover_rest_cure_hp_percent 50) save the games where the Borg rests under an archer it cannot see, which the normal world shows only rarely? experiment.name: reborn-archer-worlds-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-22: borg-reborn-rs owner, "ask the zoo to create a world with more archers to test this" and "dispatch the archer world pilot" (borg-zoo#706; the pilot only, later tiers after the gate and the owner).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-22, before any game of this build was played in these worlds (borg-zoo#706; borg-reborn-rs #981, #982, PRs #998, #999; RULES 21).
Four arms (ctl = shipped, both rules on; shotoff; cureoff; off = the play before #998/#999) in archers-x8 and archers-x4 (8 profiles), classes-18,
18 starts each (144 cells), 100,000 turns, evidence retained. A world's arms are compared only within that world (ctl-x8 against x8 arms, ctl-x4
against x4 arms). Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell records its world with the same borg_world_data_sha256 in every arm of that world;
each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls apart; identical plays. Report per world, arm and
class: deaths and causes (kobold archer, scout, orc tracker, ruffian apart; any death within 200 game turns of a "You are hit by ...!" message apart),
CL and DL, paired rescued and newly killed against the world's ctl; per arm "# Resting to recover HP/SP..." notes within 50 game turns of a
"You are hit by ...!" message, the counts of "# Mode: invisible attacker near", "# Walking away from an unseen attacker", "# Mode: unseen attacker
killed", "# Mode: over (a ... which casts or shoots, died after unseen hits)", "# Cure before rest:" notes and cures drunk; world check: kobold archers
and scouts met per game ("Creating a monster 'kobold archer'" / "'scout'"). The favoured races are generated from DL4 (favour changes weights, not
depth), so games that stay above DL4 meet them only out of depth. A world is a stress test: a lead here needs the normal-world tiers before a shipped
value is judged. Directional (RULES 14).
experiment.question: In the archers-x4 and archers-x8 worlds on borg-reborn-rs d098aee7 (track-p 5cb95bc0 plus #998 and #999, both rules shipped on), do the unseen-shooter rule (#981, recover_unseen_shot) and the cure-before-rest rule (#982, recover_rest_cure_hp_percent 50) save the games where the Borg rests under an archer it cannot see, which the normal world shows only rarely? Each world has its own control.
